verdict: A single finite topology-preserving coframe prototype is executable end to end on the listed nonlinear noiseless examples. It is not a general recovery guarantee. The weak-phase example remains unresolved.
procedure: persistent circular coordinates; reject ambiguous rank or uncertified primitive finite-complex free classes
local PCA tangent estimates and overlap transfer
one global real local-affine potential; analytic encoder derivatives; normalized regularized invariant-coframe least squares
single periodic snapshot decoder with structured delayed windows and derivative consistency
sampled phase fields and explicit model paths; held-out reconstruction and diagnostics

equations.transfer: J_i=P0 Q_(i+1); A_i=(J_i^T J_i)^(-1) J_i^T P1 Q_i
equations.connection_to_pdf: dPhi=2pi Pi^(-1) beta; E=W Pi/(2pi) in the exact construction

conditions: connected compact boundaryless r-dimensional C2 manifold M
eta_x is an isomorphism on T_x M everywhere
image of all loop periods is exactly 2pi Z^r
exact_sufficient_statement.conclusion: Phi=integral eta mod 2pi is a global diffeomorphism M to T^r; dynamics become a constant translation; dual fields commute and are complete.
exact_sufficient_statement.finite_status: The prototype preserves initial cohomology classes exactly, but checks nondegeneracy and inverse consistency only on samples. A finite-complex certificate is not a manifold certificate.

protocol.selection: smallest validation window NRMSE among train+validation nondegenerate orientation-consistent coframes
protocol.truth: only phase scoring after fit and model selection are frozen
protocol.encoder_derivatives: analytic derivative of the actual frozen encoder, independently checked by finite differences
protocol.rank_gates: minimum sigma_min/sigma_max >1e-3 and minimum sigma_min/initial-gradient-RMS >1e-3, with transported sampled orientation consistency
protocol.negative_variant: A constant-per-chart correction has an unavoidable local rank defect at points with fewer than r+1 active weights; local-affine features remove this obstruction.

remaining_limits: r is selected by a finite persistence-gap heuristic, not universally determined; the weak-phase test fails at this step.
All tests are noiseless, L=2, with rich instantaneous sensor observations; sparse noninjective snapshots are untested.
The second seed changes channel mixing, not the underlying phase trajectory.
All selected lambda values are at the upper end of the declared candidate grid; this is not an optimum certificate.
The finite regularized objective generally biases the exact invariant solution.
Decoder fields commute exactly on the parameter torus; fields are single-valued on its image only if the decoder is an embedding.
Field consistency with measured tangent directions remains approximate, about 3 to 15 percent in these tests.
Sampled rank/cycle checks do not prove global injectivity or a correct true-manifold topology.
Observed held-out windows are supplied to the encoder. These results measure reconstruction, not forecasting.
Reconstruction covers measured sensor values; a continuous spatial field away from sensors needs a separate identifiable spatial model.
